findings.subject: Cueva del Pirul Coyotlatelco archaeobotanical contextual distributions
findings.assertion: In Coyotlatelco contexts at Cueva del Pirul, the 2025 report identifies chenopod and maize macrobotanical remains in silo, hearth and burial contexts; amaranth in silos and burials; beans and purslane in silos; nopal/tuna and jaltomate in hearths and burials; chia in hearths.
findings.source_locator: journal p.165 (PDF page index 2), paragraph 'In the Cueva del Pirul'
findings.independence: not independently corroborated; original 1993–1996 assemblages revisited
findings.limitations: No original sample-by-sample supplementary Table 1 or laboratory catalog inspected; phase attribution not independently verified
findings.location: Cueva del Pirul, Teotihuacan, State of Mexico
findings.educational_use: Post-Teotihuacan food processing and reuse of quarry cavities

findings.subject: Cueva del Pirul Mazapa and later botanical contexts
findings.assertion: For Mazapa contexts at Cueva del Pirul, the 2025 report identifies amaranth, chenopod, maize, jaltomate and purslane in hearths and burials, with Phaseolus limited to silo contexts and chia in hearths; its Aztec-period samples yielded maize, amaranth and chenopod in hearths.
findings.source_locator: journal p.165 (PDF page index 2), same Cueva del Pirul paragraph
findings.limitations: Cannot infer taxonomic consumption, quantities or absence outside examined samples; supplemental context register not inspected
findings.period: Mazapa approx. AD 900–1150 and subsequent Aztec occupation
findings.location: Cueva del Pirul, Teotihuacan, State of Mexico
findings.educational_use: Chronology of domestic use in quarry tunnels

disputes.topic: Coyotlatelco Amaranthus context discrepancy in Cueva de las Varillas
disputes.earlier: 1996 printed p.6 says clearly identified Amaranthus occurred in 21.4% of contexts, ONLY associated with burials
disputes.later: 2025 journal p.165 says Coyotlatelco Varillas amaranth occurred in silos and hearths, ABSENT from burials
disputes.assessment: unresolved conflicting descriptions of same excavations; not independent corroboration
disputes.next_check: 2025 supplementary Table 1, lab context register; compare 1996 sample list

disputes.earlier: 1996 printed p.6 says maize 35.7% of Varillas Coyotlatelco/Late Coyotlatelco contexts, in hearths AND associated with burials
disputes.later: 2025 journal p.165 says Coyotlatelco Varillas maize in silos and hearths, ABSENT from burials
disputes.assessment: unresolved change in phase/context/sample selection; no automatic evidence promotion
disputes.next_check: match maize samples to burial context identities in 1996 and 2025 supplemental inventory

disputes.earlier: 1996 printed p.7 says Phaseolus not present in preceding Coyotlatelco/Late Coyotlatelco analyzed context group (appears in Mazapa)
disputes.later: 2025 journal p.165 says beans in Varillas Coyotlatelco silos and hearths
disputes.assessment: unresolved; may reflect reanalysis, more samples or revised phase attribution
disputes.next_check: retrieve individual Varillas bean contexts and dates

disputes.earlier: 1996 report printed p.6 pools Coyotlatelco and Late Coyotlatelco contexts approx. AD 512–1000
disputes.assessment: different temporal groupings make aggregate frequencies and contexts non-directly comparable

non_independence: 1996 and 2025 syntheses share the 1993–1996 excavations and must not be counted as independent archaeological samples
next_action: Retrieve 2025 supplementary Tables 1–3; crosswalk Varillas AA identifiers and ceramic phases to 1996 contexts; inspect Sugiyama/Sugiyama/Sarabia 2013 original Sun Pyramid tables; recheck latest canonical manifest and V87 reconciliation.
